name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest under control.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
breathingCues: Inhale on the way down, exhale as you press.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Letting the wrists bend backward.
contraindicationNotes: Stop if you feel sharp shoulder pain.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at mid-chest height.
Grip the handles and keep your back flat against the pad.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
commonMistakes: Setting the seat too low or high.
Locking the elbows hard at the top.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Sit on the bench with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Lie back and kick the dumbbells up to chest level.
Press both dumbbells up until your arms are straight.
Lower under control to chest level and repeat.
commonMistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift apart at the top.
Flaring the elbows to 90 degrees.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set the bench to a 30–45 degree incline.
Lie back with dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press up until arms are straight without clashing the dumbbells.
Lower slowly back to shoulder level.
commonMistakes: Using too steep an incline, shifting load to shoulders.
Arching the lower back off the pad.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Push-Up
instructions: Start in a plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Push back up to the starting position without letting hips sag.
breathingCues: Inhale down, exhale as you push.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips sag or pike.
Partial range of motion.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Knee Push-Up
instructions: Kneel on the floor, hands under shoulders, body straight from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Push back up keeping that straight line.
commonMistakes: Bending at the hips instead of staying straight.
Dropping the head forward.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells held above your chest, palms facing.
With a slight bend in the elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together over your chest.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows too much, turning it into a press.
Going too deep and straining the shoulders.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Conventional Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar over the middle of your feet.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Flatten your back, pull the slack out, and brace.
Push the floor away and stand tall, keeping the bar close.
Hinge the bar back down under control.
breathingCues: Brace before each rep; exhale at the top.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back.
Pulling with the arms before the hips rise.
contraindicationNotes: Learn the hip hinge with a light load first.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand holding the bar at hip level with a slight knee bend.
Push your hips back and lower the bar along your thighs.
Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
commonMistakes: Bending the knees too much, turning it into a squat.
Rounding the back at the bottom.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
instructions: Hold the bar with an overhand grip, feet hip-width.
Hinge until your torso is about 45 degrees, back flat.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower under control without standing up.
commonMistakes: Jerking the torso to move the weight.
Letting the shoulders shrug toward the ears.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a bench, back flat.
Hold the dumbbell in the free hand, arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close to your body.
Lower under control and repeat before switching sides.
commonMistakes: Twisting the torso to lift the weight.
Pulling to the chest instead of the hip.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit with thighs secured under the pad, grip the bar wider than shoulders.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Return the bar slowly to the start with straight arms.
breathingCues: Exhale as you pull, inhale as you release.
commonMistakes: Pulling behind the neck.
Swinging the body for momentum.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Assisted Pull-Up
instructions: Set the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull your chest to the bar without kicking.
Lower under control to straight arms.
commonMistakes: Using too much assistance and losing tension.
Swinging at the bottom.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar, driving elbows down and back.
Lower under control to a full hang.
commonMistakes: Kicking or kipping to finish the rep.
Stopping short of a full hang between reps.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit tall with feet on the platform and a neutral grip on the handle.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs, squeezing the shoulder blades.
Keep your chest up and elbows close.
Extend the arms back out under control.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back and leaning far forward.
Shrugging instead of rowing.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Band Pull-Apart
instructions: Hold a band in front of your chest with straight arms, hands shoulder-width.
Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Squeeze the shoulder blades, then return slowly.
commonMistakes: Bending the elbows to cheat.
Shrugging the shoulders.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Back Squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back, grip it outside your shoulders.
Unrack, step back, and set feet about shoulder-width.
Brace, then sit your hips down and back until thighs are parallel.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
breathingCues: Big breath and brace before descending; exhale at the top.
commonMistakes: Knees collapsing inward.
Heels lifting off the floor.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Squat down keeping your chest up until thighs are near parallel.
Drive through your feet to stand.
commonMistakes: Letting the knees cave inward.
Leaning too far forward.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Bodyweight Squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width, arms out in front or at your sides.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest up.
Descend until thighs are near parallel, then stand back up.
commonMistakes: Knees collapsing inward.
Lifting the heels.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit in the machine with back and head against the pad.
Place feet shoulder-width on the platform and release the safety.
Lower the platform until your knees are about 90 degrees.
Press the platform back up without locking your knees.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back round off the pad.
Locking the knees at the top.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a step in front of a bench, rest your rear foot on it.
Hold dumbbells at your sides and keep your torso upright.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Drive through the front foot to stand, then switch legs.
commonMistakes: Leaning far forward onto the front leg.
Letting the front knee cave inward.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one leg back and lower until both knees are near 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs each rep.
commonMistakes: Stepping directly behind, losing balance.
Pushing off the back foot.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Step-Up
instructions: Stand facing a knee-height bench holding dumbbells.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Drive through that foot to step up, bringing the other leg along.
Step back down under control and repeat.
commonMistakes: Pushing off the bottom leg.
Using a bench that is too high.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Sit with your back on the pad and ankles behind the roller.
Extend your knees to lift the weight until your legs are straight.
Lower under control without letting the stack touch.
commonMistakes: Kicking the weight up with momentum.
Hips sliding forward off the seat.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Adjust the pad to rest just above your heels and secure your thighs.
Curl your legs down as far as the machine allows.
Return slowly to the start without letting the stack touch.
commonMistakes: Lifting the hips off the seat.
Using momentum instead of a controlled curl.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the machine platform with shoulders under the pads.
Let your heels drop below the platform for a stretch.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as possible.
Lower under control and repeat.
commonMistakes: Bouncing at the bottom.
Bending the knees throughout.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand tall with the balls of your feet on a step edge or flat ground.
Lower your heels for a stretch.
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible, pause, then lower.
commonMistakes: Rushing the reps.
Rolling the ankles outward.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench, bar over your hips with padding.
Plant your feet so your shins are vertical at the top.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight from knees to shoulders.
Lower under control without resting the bar on the floor.
commonMistakes: Overarching the lower back at the top.
Feet placed too far forward or back.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near your hips.
Push through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back instead of squeezing the glutes.
Pushing through the toes.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Overhead Barbell Press
instructions: Hold the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.
breathingCues: Exhale as you press, inhale on the way down.
commonMistakes: Leaning back and turning it into an incline press.
Pressing the bar out in front instead of up.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press both dumbbells overhead until arms are nearly straight.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.
commonMistakes: Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides.
Arching the back off the support.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with light dumbbells at your sides, slight elbow bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Lower under control without swinging.
commonMistakes: Using momentum to swing the weight up.
Raising above shoulder height and shrugging.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Dumbbell Rear-Delt Fly
instructions: Hinge forward until your torso is near parallel, dumbbells hanging.
With a slight elbow bend, raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower under control.
commonMistakes: Standing up to cheat the weight.
Turning it into a row by bending the elbows.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Dumbbell Shrug
instructions: Stand tall with heavy dumbbells at your sides.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
commonMistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles.
Bending the arms to help.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Keep your elbows pinned and curl the dumbbells to shoulder height.
Lower under control to a straight arm.
commonMistakes: Swinging the torso to move the weight.
Letting the elbows drift forward.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your body.
Curl the dumbbells up keeping that neutral grip.
Lower under control to straight arms.
commonMistakes: Swinging the weights.
Rotating the wrists during the rep.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Band Curl
instructions: Stand on the middle of a band, holding the ends with palms forward.
Curl your hands to shoulder height, elbows pinned.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
commonMistakes: Stepping off the band and losing tension.
Letting the elbows drift forward.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Stand at a cable station, grip the bar or rope at chest height.
Pin your elbows at your sides and push down until arms are straight.
Return slowly to about 90 degrees without letting elbows rise.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows drift forward and using the shoulders.
Leaning far over the stack for momentum.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Sit on a bench edge, hands beside your hips, feet out in front.
Slide off the bench and lower your body until elbows are about 90 degrees.
Push back up through your palms without shrugging.
commonMistakes: Letting the shoulders roll forward.
Going too deep and straining the shoulders.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Plank
instructions: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your core and hold without letting hips sag.
commonMistakes: Hips sagging or piking.
Holding the breath.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Side Plank
instructions: Lie on your side, forearm on the floor, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body is straight from head to feet.
Hold, then switch sides.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips drop toward the floor.
Rolling the top shoulder forward.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back, arms overhead, legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lift your head, shoulders, and legs slightly off the floor.
Hold while keeping the lower back glued down.
commonMistakes: Lower back peeling off the floor.
Bending the knees and losing the hollow shape.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms up, knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lower the opposite arm and leg toward the floor slowly.
Return and switch sides while keeping your back flat.
commonMistakes: Letting the lower back arch off the floor.
Moving too fast.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Crunch
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands across your chest or by your ears.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, squeezing your abs.
Lower back down under control without pulling on your neck.
commonMistakes: Pulling on the neck.
Using momentum to sit up.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Bird Dog
instructions: Start on hands and knees, wrists under shoulders.
Extend one arm and the opposite leg until they are level.
Hold briefly, return, and switch sides.
commonMistakes: Rotating the hips instead of staying level.
Lifting the limbs too high and arching.
author: Nobelle reviewed

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
instructions: Start the treadmill at a comfortable walking speed.
Add a modest incline to raise effort without running.
Walk tall with a natural arm swing for the planned duration.
commonMistakes: Holding the rails and leaning back.
Setting a speed you cannot sustain.
author: Nobelle reviewed
